output.headline: Provider-focused sponsor with an open platform in the sub-sector, Midwest depth and a record of paying upper-quartile multiples
output.differentiator: Ties GTCR for the deepest Midwest record (6 deals) and, unlike GTCR, has an open platform in the sub-sector; its 16.2x median paid is above Advent, GTCR and TPG. [T:record, A:angles]
output.why_them: Add-on to open platform; Midwest depth; pays upper-quartile prices

acquirer_overview.title: Healthcare sponsor with 23 deals and a provider specialism
points: Financial sponsor with 23 deals between 2017 and 2023; 18 closed (78%) [T:record, K:closed_share].
Provider deals are 16 of 23: 15 in adjacent provider sub-sectors and 1 in the target's own sub-sector [A:angles, T:record].
Healthcare and technology mandate; a 2023 headline cites over $5 Billion raised in its largest private equity fund to date [P:1, P:2].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An add-on to an open platform, backed by a provider record
points: Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors are its strongest positive factor in the likelihood, though only a modest one [S:sector_rel].
Cross-sell drove 8 of 23 deals, a distinct motive against 21% of all deals in the file [M:cross_sell].
Its open platform makes the target an add-on; it has 6 deals in the Midwest and bought Jefferson Ambulatory Care there [A:angles, T:record, D:MA-2021-0083].

precedent_activity.title: Closest precedent is a Midwest deal in the target's own sub-sector
points: Jefferson Ambulatory Care: $75M Management Buyout, 2021, Midwest, 17.8x EV/EBITDA, closed [D:MA-2021-0083].
Woodland PACE: $204M Management Buyout, 2021, 17.6x, closed. Clearwater Mental Health: $398M Recapitalization, 2023, Midwest, 16.8x, withdrawn [D:MA-2021-0025, D:MA-2023-0166].
9 of its 23 deals sit in the comparable $100M-$400M size band [K:size_band].

valuation_context.title: Target margin supports the 75th percentile; buyer's history pays above it
points: 70 comparable deals show 10.7x at the lower quartile, 12.8x median and 15.3x at the 75th. Target margin of 16.8% against a 12.9% comps median supports the 75th [V:comps].
Its own median paid is 16.2x, above the comparable 75th percentile of 15.3x [T:record, V:comps].
Ability to pay: 5.0x leverage and a $128M equity cheque give 18.7% IRR at the ask against a 20% target; maximum price is $193M on a same-multiple exit, $216M on a platform exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below its 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: On a same-multiple exit the maximum is $193M, so the bid depends on underwriting the add-on exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Completion record
risk_flags.concern: 18 of 23 deals closed (78%); closing share is a slight factor against it [K:closed_share, S:close_rate_s].
risk_flags.mitigant: The listed withdrawals were recapitalizations; its listed buyouts all closed [D:MA-2023-0166, D:MA-2022-0024, D:MA-2021-0083].
risk_flags.reality: Clearwater Mental Health, a $398M Midwest deal, was withdrawn in 2023, so completion risk is real [D:MA-2023-0166].

risk_flags.title: Competitive process
risk_flags.concern: Nordic Capital and Advent International also have open platforms, and strategics Advocate Health and UPMC carry High conviction too.
risk_flags.mitigant: Welsh Carson's 6 Midwest deals and 16.2x median paid support a strong bid [T:record].
risk_flags.reality: It is fourth of 10 on the priority list at a 4.3% likelihood, so a competitive process is likely [R:rank].

conviction.rationale: One deal in the target's own sub-sector, 15 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, and an open platform in the sub-sector giving a direct add-on route to the target. [C:conviction, T:record, A:angles]
